title: Notes from a London Ward

pre.en: What doesn't Lily want her mum to know?
pre.zh: Lily 不想让妈妈知道什么？
options: That she drinks tea with milk now

intro: Lily 在伦敦一家医院的外科病房干了三个星期，在回家的公交车上给国内病区的老同事发了段语音，讲英国病房和国内有什么不同。读的时候留意 make sb do 和 help sb do：「让、帮别人做」，后面直接跟动词原形；可一变成被动，就要加 to：was made to walk。最后补的一句很好笑。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone, it's Lily!
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Lily！

sentences.en: I've been on a surgical ward in east London for three weeks now, so here's my first update.
sentences.zh: 我在伦敦东区一家医院的外科病房已经待了三个星期，先跟大家汇报一下。

sentences.en: I'm on the bus home, so sorry about the noise.
sentences.zh: 我在回家的公交车上，有点吵，不好意思。

sentences.en: I set off at a quarter past six every morning, and the bus is always full of nurses.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上六点一刻出门，车上总是挤满了护士。

sentences.en: So, the ward's often short-staffed and everyone's under pressure, just like at home.
sentences.zh: 病房经常缺人手，大家压力都很大，这点跟国内一样。

sentences.en: But some things are very different.
sentences.zh: 不过有些地方很不一样。

sentences.en: Here, the nurses make patients get out of bed on the first day after surgery.
sentences.zh: 在这儿，护士会让病人手术后第一天就下床。

sentences.en: Yesterday, an eighty-nine-year-old man was made to walk to the window.
sentences.zh: 昨天，一位八十九岁的老先生硬是被护士拉着走到窗边。

sentences.en: He complained the whole way.
sentences.zh: 他一路走一路抱怨。

sentences.en: And you have to fill in a form for almost everything.
sentences.zh: 还有，几乎干什么都得填表。

sentences.en: A senior nurse called Grace has been helping me find my feet.
sentences.zh: 有位叫 Grace 的资深护士一直在帮我适应。

sentences.en: She's gone out of her way to explain the computer system.
sentences.zh: 她专门抽时间给我讲电脑系统。

sentences.en: She even made me practise the British way of saying no.
sentences.zh: 她还让我练习英国人是怎么说「不」的。

sentences.en: Apparently, "I'm not sure that's a good idea" means "absolutely not".
sentences.zh: 据说，「我不太确定这是个好主意」，意思就是「绝对不行」。

sentences.en: British patients also tend to say sorry for everything, even when you're the one who's late.
sentences.zh: 英国病人还动不动就道歉，哪怕迟到的明明是你。

sentences.en: Handover takes thirty minutes, and people take their breaks seriously.
sentences.zh: 交接班要半个小时，大家也很把休息当回事。

sentences.en: Nobody skips lunch here!
sentences.zh: 在这儿，没人不吃午饭！

sentences.en: Oh, and we had a mystery.
sentences.zh: 哦对了，我们还碰上一桩怪事。

sentences.en: Pens kept disappearing from a drawer at the nurses' station, and it took a week to get to the bottom of it.
sentences.zh: 护士站抽屉里的笔老是不见，查了一个星期才弄清楚。

sentences.en: It was the same eighty-nine-year-old man.
sentences.zh: 原来还是那位八十九岁的老先生。

sentences.en: He was building a little tower made of pens.
sentences.zh: 他在用笔搭一座小塔。

sentences.en: He'd also taken his TV remote apart, just to see how it worked.
sentences.zh: 他还把电视遥控器拆了，说只是想看看里面怎么回事。

sentences.en: The hardest part is working nights in English.
sentences.zh: 最难的是用英语上夜班。

sentences.en: At three in the morning, my English goes to bed before I do.
sentences.zh: 一到凌晨三点，我的英语比我先睡着。

sentences.en: Anyway, I'd be grateful if someone could send me the new rota for June.
sentences.zh: 好了，要是谁能把六月的新排班表发我一份，我就太感谢了。

sentences.en: And let me know how everything is on Ward 6.
sentences.zh: 也跟我说说六病区最近怎么样。

sentences.en: I miss you all!
sentences.zh: 想你们！

sentences.en: Oh, one more thing.
sentences.zh: 哦，还有一件事。

sentences.en: I've started drinking tea with milk.
sentences.zh: 我开始喝加奶的茶了。

sentences.en: Please don't tell my mum.
sentences.zh: 千万别告诉我妈。

cards.note: ward 是病房、病区；外科病房 surgical ward，儿科病房 children's ward。
to start a journey
cards.tip: set 的三种形式一样；去哪儿用 for：set off for work。
cards.example: We set off early to avoid the traffic.

cards.note: to not have enough workers
cards.tip: 常说医院、餐厅、商店；同义说法 be understaffed。
cards.example: We're short-staffed this week because two people are ill.

cards.note: to feel worried because you have too much to do or people expect a lot from you
cards.tip: 被谁逼着做某事：be under pressure to do sth；介词固定用 under。
cards.example: I work better when I'm not under pressure.

cards.note: 说「做手术」常用 have surgery，不加 a；英式里 surgery 还指诊所。
to write the information that is asked for on a form
cards.tip: 英式多说 fill in，美式多说 fill out；代词放中间：fill it in。
cards.example: Please fill in this form and bring it to reception.

cards.note: 反义 junior；senior citizens 是老年人。

cards.zh: （在新环境里）站稳脚跟；适应过来
cards.note: to become confident in a new place or job
cards.tip: your 要跟着主语换：find my feet / find her feet；find 的过去式 found。
cards.example: It took me a few months to find my feet in London.

cards.text: go out of your way to do
cards.note: to make a special effort to do something, especially to help someone
表示「听别人说的、不是我亲眼确认的」，口语里很常用。
医院里的交接班；动词词组是 hand over（第 34 课的 hand sth over）。
to think that something is important and give it attention
cards.tip: 东西放中间：take it seriously；反过来「别太当真」是 Don't take it too seriously。
cards.example: He doesn't take his health seriously.

cards.text: get to the bottom of sth
cards.zh: 查个水落石出；弄清根本原因
cards.note: to find out the real cause of a problem
to have something as its material
cards.tip: 看得出原材料用 of；原材料变了样（如葡萄酿酒）用 from：Wine is made from grapes。
cards.example: The table is made of old wood from a farm.

cards.note: to separate something into its different parts
remote control 的口语简称；作形容词是「遥远的」：a remote village。
to work during the night instead of the day
cards.tip: nights 不加介词也不加冠词；也说 be on nights / work night shifts。
cards.example: My dad worked nights for twenty years.

cards.zh: 如果……我将不胜感激（礼貌请求）
cards.note: a polite way to ask someone to do something, often used in formal emails
cards.tip: 后面常接 you could …；比 Please … 客气，比 Can you … 正式。
cards.example: I'd be grateful if you could reply by Friday.

cards.note: 英式说法，美式多说 schedule。

cards.zh: 告诉某人一声；通知某人
cards.note: to tell someone about something
